questions.def: Use 'had + past participle' to express regret about the past.
questions.question: I wish I ___ harder in school now.

questions.def: 'Wish + past perfect' expresses regret about a past action.
questions.question: She wishes she ___ the job offer.

questions.def: Use 'were' after 'wish' to express a desire for something untrue.
questions.question: I wish I ___ taller.

questions.def: 'Had had' is the past perfect of 'have', used after 'wish'.
questions.question: They wish they ___ more time to finish the project.

questions.def: Use 'had + past participle' after 'wish' for past regrets.
questions.question: I wish you ___ me earlier about the problem.

questions.def: Use 'would' to express a wish about a future event.
questions.question: I wish it ___ tomorrow.

questions.def: Use 'hadn't + past participle' for past regrets with 'wish'.
questions.question: He wishes he ___ so much money last night.

questions.def: 'Wish + past simple' expresses a desire for a present unreal situation.
questions.question: I wish I ___ the answer to that question.

questions.def: Use 'weren't' after 'wish' to express a contrary present state.
questions.question: I wish I ___ so tired right now.

questions.def: 'Wish + past simple (were)' expresses a present wish.
questions.question: She wishes her boss ___ so demanding.

questions.def: 'Wish + past perfect' expresses regret about something said/done.
questions.question: I wish I ___ that embarrassing thing at the party.

questions.def: Use 'would' after 'wish' to express a desire for change.
questions.question: I wish it ___ raining.

questions.def: 'Wish + past simple' expresses a present desire for something unreal.
questions.question: I wish I ___ a better plan for my future.

questions.def: Use 'were' after 'wish' to express a hypothetical situation.
questions.question: She wishes she ___ able to travel more often.

questions.def: 'Wish + past perfect' to express regret about a past action.

questions.def: 'Wish + past simple' expresses a desire for a different present.

questions.def: 'Wish + past perfect' expresses regret about something said.

questions.def: 'Wish + past simple' expresses a desire for a different present.
questions.question: She wishes she ___ more supportive friends.

questions.def: 'Wish + past perfect' expresses regret about the past.
questions.question: I wish I ___ the lottery.

questions.def: 'Wish + past perfect' expresses regret about forgotten birthday.
questions.question: I wish I ___ his birthday.

questions.def: 'Wish + past simple' (were) expresses a present unreal wish.
questions.question: I wish it ___ so cold today.

questions.def: 'Wish + past simple' expresses a desire for present unreal situation.

questions.def: Use 'had + past participle' to express regret about the past.
questions.question: I wish I ___ harder in school when I was younger.

questions.def: 'Wish' about the past requires the past perfect tense.
questions.question: She wishes she ___ the truth to him yesterday.

questions.def: Use 'were' instead of 'was' after 'wish' for hypothetical situations.
questions.question: I wish I ___ taller.

questions.def: 'Wish' about a past event takes the past perfect tense.
questions.question: They wish they ___ to the party last night.

questions.def: 'Wish' + 'would' expresses annoyance or a desire for change.
questions.question: I wish you ___ making so much noise.

questions.def: 'Wish' about the future uses 'would' to express a desire.
questions.question: I wish it ___ tomorrow.

questions.def: 'If only' is similar to 'I wish' and takes past perfect for past regrets.
questions.question: If only I ___ more time to travel.
